DIAGNOSIS READY: Craniopharyngioma.

The onset of inappropriate sexual behavior, specific cravings for high-calorie foods (chocolate, chips), and significant weight gain in a 55-year-old male strongly suggests hypothalamic dysfunction. I need to confirm the location of the lesion and assess for other hormonal deficits.
